key.decision_why: The author answered the feedback by editing the description and opening an api-design discussion, but pushed no code, so a short note on what was and wasn't addressed is enough and a new card is not needed.
key.action_why: The issue requires the standard API-change documentation, and the PR still has no API changelog entry or feature-level update, so a careful triager would keep "not ready" and ask for those, not hand off.
changed: The author says the PR description now has a screenshot of the rendered API documentation.

still_missing: There is no API changelog entry (no api_docs/unmerged.d file) and no feature-level note for this API change, which issue #20229 explicitly asks for.
The #api design discussion was only just started, has no link in the PR, and has reached no agreement yet.
No new code was pushed after the feedback: the head commit is unchanged and only the description was edited.
key.reply_ask: Ask the author to add an API changelog entry (api_docs/unmerged.d with feature-level notes in zulip.yaml) as API changes require, and to link the #api design topic in the PR so maintainers can follow the decision.

must_have.fact: Says the PR still lacks an API changelog entry / feature-level documentation (no api_docs/unmerged.d file), which issue #20229 requires for this API change.
Says no new code was pushed since the feedback; the only changes are the description screenshot and a new CZO #api design topic.
Notes that the #api design discussion has only just started and has reached no agreement, so the API change isn't approved yet.
Recommends keeping "not ready" and giving more feedback, not handing off to a reviewer.
Mentions that issue #20229 has no "help wanted" label and that zulipbot flagged the author's attempt to claim it.
